source_snapshot.test_name: All SAS/SATA Slot Number Check - NVMe
source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Insert all NVMe SSDs into backplane slots and verify each slot number against system specification.
procedure_facts: Requires physical insertion and observation, but provides no enumeration command or evidence method.
source_conflicts: Test-set and name prefix say SAS/SATA while suffix/procedure explicitly target NVMe and an NVMe adapter.
missing_source_information: Chassis/backplane/adapter port-to-slot-to-serial map, insertion SOP, enumeration source and recovery.

original_test_intent.statement: After the storage protocol scope is formally corrected, physically populate every approved slot with the designated drives and verify each stable device identity maps to the system-defined physical slot number.
must_preserve: All in-scope slots and physical insertion.
must_not_infer: NVMe from category or SAS/SATA from prefix without correction.
Linux `/dev/nvmeX` or controller enumeration order as physical slot number.
One detected device as evidence for all slots.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly rejects pure automation, flags SAS/SATA versus NVMe naming, and requires operator photos/serials plus complete PCI/sysfs topology rather than device order.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not classify the protocol mismatch as SOURCE_CONFLICT, define hot-plug versus cold insertion and ESD/power boundaries, or require one-to-one coverage and negative detection for empty/unexpected slots.

related_records: The NVMe switch BIOS case cannot define this row's backplane slot numbering or protocol scope.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Contradictory source fields require formal correction; V3 cannot silently choose NVMe despite procedure evidence.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Do not insert drives until the owner resolves SAS/SATA versus NVMe and supplies the physical map/SOP. After that, operator insertion plus automated topology correlation is a hybrid flow.

conditions_present: All-slot physical mapping intent is clear.
missing: Protocol scope, drive/slot map, power/hot-plug/ESD SOP, enumeration method, expected link/controller values and recovery.
provider: Platform/storage owner corrects protocol and supplies map/spec.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory current enclosure/backplane/controller/PCIe/SAS/NVMe topology and logs without moving drives.
prohibited_until_resolved: Drive insertion/removal, power/hot-plug, formatting/writes, log clearing or PASS.
closure_evidence: Formal protocol correction and signed slot map.
Complete physical and electronic identity evidence for every slot.

revision_candidate.purpose: After formal protocol-scope correction, verify every in-scope physical backplane/adapter slot maps the designated drive's persistent serial/WWN/EUI identity to the exact system-defined slot number, with no missing, duplicated or unexpected mapping.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact chassis, backplane/adapter/controller/expander/switch, cabling, firmware and drive protocol selected by the correction. NVMe PCIe and SAS/SATA enclosure mappings are not interchangeable.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every slot on the signed map and every designated drive, including expected empty slots. One insertion observation and one independent controller/OS/BMC/enclosure topology view per mapping.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Formal SAS/SATA-or-NVMe decision; chassis/backplane/controller slot labels; port/lane/BDF/enclosure-to-slot map; drive serial/model/firmware list; cold/hot-plug capability; power/ESD/insertion SOP; expected link state; maintenance/operator/recovery approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture baseline map, power state and logs. Qualified operator follows the approved cold or hot insertion SOP and records each drive serial at the labeled slot. After stabilization, collect the protocol-appropriate complete topology/enclosure/PCIe/NVMe/SAS evidence without relying on transient names, correlate every serial to one physical slot and verify empty/unexpected slots, then capture health/logs. Agent cannot perform physical actions.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Source conflict resolved; exact parts/map/SOP/operator/window available; data protected; management/recovery path ready; hot-plug support proven if used.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Correction decision; server/backplane/controller firmware; signed expected map; operator photos/checklist with slot labels and serials; complete persistent drive identity and protocol topology; slot/enclosure/BDF/port/link correlation; missing/duplicate/unexpected analysis; kernel/controller/AER/SEL logs; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed platform slot map for the corrected protocol. Pass requires one-to-one mapping for every in-scope drive/slot, correct empty-slot state, expected link/controller health and no insertion/system error; device enumeration order alone is invalid.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not choose protocol, hot-plug without support, insert/remove under unsafe power, skip ESD, rely on `/dev` order, expose protected data, format/write, omit slots, clear logs or claim physical observation by an Agent.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Platform/storage owner corrects scope and approves map/SOP; qualified operator performs insertions; engineer judges mapping/errors.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical placement is manual; topology collection/correlation can be automated after handoff.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On missing/wrong device, link/AER/controller/boot issue, stop further insertions, preserve evidence, power down if required, restore original population under SOP and verify storage/host health.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Protocol conflict/map/SOP/operator/recovery missing; part/slot mismatch; power/ESD uncertainty; unexpected drive/data exposure; duplicate/missing identity; link/controller/AER error; management/boot regression; incomplete evidence.

identified_defects: SAS/SATA category conflicts with NVMe procedure.
No persistent drive-to-slot map or insertion SOP.
reason_for_change: Prevent the agent from choosing a protocol or equating transient enumeration with physical slot numbers while preserving the all-slot physical validation.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-Storage-00101-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: SAS/SATA labels, NVMe procedure, all-slot insertion and specification comparison.

removed_ambiguities: Separates physical slot from device order.
Requires one-to-one coverage and empty-slot analysis.
resolved_blockers: Operator/topology collection is feasible after correction; not inherently BLOCKED.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 stops before choosing SAS/SATA or NVMe, then requires an operator-recorded serial at every physical label plus an independent protocol-specific topology mapping, including expected empty slots.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator preserved the unresolved protocol decision, every populated and expected-empty slot, persistent identity and independent topology views; it rejected `/dev` order and correctly treated missing handoff inputs as resolvable rather than inherent BLOCKED.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 118 is labeled SAS/SATA but instructs insertion of all NVMe SSDs and checking slot numbers.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 flags mismatch; V3 makes it SOURCE_CONFLICT and adds physical/protocol mapping gates.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Inventory only until protocol/map/SOP/operator approval closes.
